entities.name: GTPase Der (B1KLB1)
observations: The query sequence is an exact 488-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt B1KLB1 from Shewanella woodyi.
Annotated as a GTPase essential for late steps of ribosome biogenesis; associates with the 50S ribosomal subunit.
Sequence scans identify tandem MMR_HSR1-family GTPase domains and a C-terminal KH_dom-like domain.

entities.name: Late ribosome biogenesis
observations: Reviewed UniProt annotation describes Der GTPase as acting in essential late steps of ribosome biogenesis.
